city_model.name: Emmer-Compascuum (with PV)
city_model.description: Emmer-Compascuum: BAG + 3DBAG LoD 0/1/2 + EP-online, extended with PV panel polygons from the University of Groningen aerial-imagery dataset (Zenodo 14860030, CC-BY-4.0). PV panels are attached as nrg3:PhotovoltaicCollector features with lod2MultiSurface geometry, lifted to the roof plane Z at the panel centroid plus a flat 0.1 m Z offset.
